ios.desc:
Shotup AI learns and remembers your screenshots.
It understands the context and visuals of your shots, and answers any questions about them in chat.

We all take screenshots — of posts, articles, restaurants, maps, design inspiration - things we considered important to save and revisit later. However, many of them end up forgotten, buried deep in our photo album. Rarely do we scroll through hundreds of images to find the one we need. What if you had a second brain — a photographic memory - that could remember not just the image but the entire context of every screenshot you’ve ever taken?

We are introducing Shotup AI. It doesn’t just store your screenshots — it learns from them. Whether you’re trying to recall an article or a social media post with tips, life hacks, or restaurant recommendations, Shotup AI gives you the references and insights you need based on the stored screenshot knowledge. It’s more than a chatting AI. It’s your backup memory.

How it works:
1. Select and sync screenshots you want the AI to remember.
2. The AI learns the context and visuals of the selected screenshots, and organizes key information.
3. Ask anything about the synced shots. Shotup AI will answer based on the relevant knowledge it learned from your screenshots.
4. You can also pick from 'Suggested Questions,' the question options Shotup AI generated based on the screenshot information it learned. 

For shoppers: Take screenshots of nice jacket or shoes you saw on Amazon, the brand websites or even on the instagram ads. Shotup AI will organize and list down all the items you took from different sites.

For students: Take screenshots of your note, online articles, life hacks or tips so Shotup AI can give you reminders and summarize relevant information whenever you need.

For designers: Take screenshots of design references, art pieces, mood board, fonts, color codes and more. Shotup AI will suggest relevant shots you took when you need inspiration from your past savings. You can ask - "Show me the warm cozy interior design references I saved." and it will find the right screenshots from you synced list. 

For everyone: Take screenshots of nice restaurants on Google Map, so it can suggest nice restaurants around there when you ask later. You can also take screenshots of your Whatsapp chat so it remembers your meeting schedule, time and location. 

Support & Feedback: hello@shotup.ai

quotes.text:
Hi HN, Gunhee and Harry here.
We're excited to launch Shotup AI — an AI assistant that learns and remembers your screenshots.

Many of us take screenshots to save important info, but over time, our photo albums become chaotic, and it’s almost impossible to find the right information when we need it.

The AI understands the content and context of your shots. It lets you search by description, like "The modern interior design reference I saw on Instagram." It helps you recap, organize, and remind you about important saved info.

How it works:

1. Select and sync your screenshots from your photo album

2. Choose recommended custom questions based on your shots or ask Shotup AI anything via chat

3. Get weekly and monthly recap summaries to rediscover forgotten saves

We believe screenshots are the new bookmarks for mobile. If you have any questions or suggestions for features, please share. Would love your feedback.

Website: https://shotup.ai

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/shotup-ai/id6738339711
